title: Filipino Kaldereta Macaroni Casserole
description: A creamy, rich, and hearty Filipino-inspired macaroni casserole dish made with ground beef and served with a side of steamed vegetables.

ingredients.name: Kaldereta sauce
ingredients.notes: available in most Asian grocery stores

instructions: Cook the macaroni in boiling salted water until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking into small pieces.
Add the kaldereta sauce, tomato sauce, and cooked macaroni. Stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with shredded cheddar cheese and milk.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
